Add-on Selection & Premium Inputs

Select a cover to activate it and configure its premium inputs.

Add-on covers
Engine Protection (Platinum) is automatically rated on IDV using the supplied age/class table. The age band is determined from the exact Date of Purchase and Date of Renewal anniversary. Select the cover above to include its calculated premium. This is before GST.
Enter Date of Purchase and Date of Renewal. Rate is applied to IDV by vehicle class and completed vehicle-age year.
Annual rates by vehicle age: Private car/two-wheeler 0.10%, 0.12%, 0.15%, 0.17%, 0.20%; commercial vehicles 0.15%, 0.18%, 0.22%, 0.25%, 0.30%. Long-term new vehicle rates: private car 3-year 0.27%; two-wheeler 5-year 0.45%. Calculated on IDV; confirm insurer terms.
Fixed premium ₹50 when selected.
Rates vary by vehicle class and annual or bundled long-term policy. Based on the supplied rating schedule.
Premium is a fixed amount: ₹250 for ₹5,000 cover or ₹500 for ₹10,000 cover. Available for OD/package policies in this calculator; confirm insurer eligibility.
Premium is per seat, excluding GST: ₹5 lakh SI ₹90 annual / ₹224 for 3 years; ₹10 lakh SI ₹180 / ₹448; ₹15 lakh SI ₹270 / ₹672. Enter seating capacity. Only 1-year and 3-year rates are supplied.
Premium is calculated automatically as a percentage of IDV based on vehicle age: below 1 year 0.14%; 1 to below 2 years 0.20%; 2 to below 3 years 0.24%; 3 to below 4 years 0.28%; 4 to below 5 years 0.30%. Two-wheelers only; confirm insurer terms.
Annual package policy premiums: ₹25,000 SI ₹1,000; ₹50,000 SI ₹2,000; ₹1,00,000 SI ₹4,000; ₹2,00,000 SI ₹8,000. New private-car 3-year package schedule: ₹2,500 / ₹5,000 / ₹10,000 / ₹20,000. The long-term table says “Annual Premium”; confirm whether those amounts are annual or total-term before quoting.
Select Consumables Add-on to calculate the supplied age/vehicle-class IDV rate automatically. Loss of Key is rated separately using the supplied vehicle-class and policy-term schedule. Road tax cover uses 1.67% of road tax paid; electrical fittings use 4% of declared value; Select Built in CNG/LPG, or choose CNG/LPG as the fuel type, to apply 2% of Basic Own Damage before discount and ₹60 third-party liability. Tick CNG/LPG Kit to insure the kit under OD at 4% of its declared value; waived for factory-fitted kits as configured. Confirm applicable insurer tariff.
Fixed calculation base
Rates are suggested from vehicle age and class; confirm eligibility and the applicable insurer tariff before quoting.
Enter Date of Purchase and Date of Renewal, then select the required NCB to calculate Nil Depreciation.
Fully electric private car: 0.25%, 0.30%, 0.35%, 0.40% and 0.50% of IDV for successive age bands below 5 years. Hybrid private-car rates remain 0.15%, 0.20%, 0.25%, 0.30% and 0.35%. Fully electric commercial PCVs and GCVs (including electric passenger-carrying three-wheelers): 0.30%, 0.35% and 0.40% of IDV for vehicle ages below 1, 1 to below 2 and 2 to below 3 years. Fully electric two-wheelers: below 1 year = 0.20% of IDV; 1 year to below 2 years = 0.30% of IDV; 2 years to below 3 years = 0.35% of IDV. This calculator limits Electric Vehicle Protect to 2.5 years of vehicle age. The cover is calculated on IDV and is available only with OD/package cover, subject to insurer terms.
Private car: 0.15% of IDV. Passenger-carrying taxi with seating capacity up to 6 passengers: 0.24% of IDV. Cover wording: NCB accrued at renewal is maintained for up to two admissible package-policy claims during the policy period. Renewal eligibility and insurer terms must be verified.
Private car: 6.60% of monthly EMI; two-wheeler: 2.00%; passenger-carrying taxi up to 6 passengers: 6.60%; other commercial vehicles: 3.00%. Enter monthly EMI above. Check applicable class exclusions and insurer terms.
